items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 29 July 2026 at 8:10am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centred to the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, veering this evening and at first tonight to between West and North 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in southeast of area, then becoming West 3 or 4 in all waters later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mist patches at first, then light and patchy rain for a time later today, becoming fair later this evening and at first tonight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain, and poor in any mist patches at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 later in day.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
